loopback_binding.mechanism: _is_loopback_host() check in DesktopBridgeServer.start(). Rejects non-loopback hosts unless RIG_RELAY_ALLOW_NON_LOOPBACK_LOCAL_BRIDGE env var is set.
loopback_binding.notes: Default bind is 127.0.0.1. Explicit unsafe/dev flag required for any non-loopback bind.

origin_validation.null_origin_policy: Allowed — pywebview sends null origin for file:// loads in local webview
origin_validation.missing_origin_policy: Allowed — curl, health probes, and local tools may not send Origin
origin_validation.file_origin_policy: Never allowed — file:// origins rejected unconditionally
origin_validation.notes: Origin validation on both HTTP (bridge_server._handle_http) and WebSocket (websocket_server._inspect_origin) surfaces.

host_validation.rejected_hosts_behavior: 403 Forbidden with JSON error response. DNS-rebinding hostnames like evil.example.com resolving to 127.0.0.1 are rejected.
host_validation.notes: Host header validated in _handle_http() before any route processing.

websocket_protection.notes: WebSocket connections validate Origin in process_request handler and require token auth as first message. Reconnect goes through full auth cycle.

service_state_gating.locked_behavior: Sensitive HTTP routes return 403. Sensitive intents refused with service_gated error code.
service_state_gating.setup_required_behavior: Same as locked — no sensitive operations until profile is created and unlocked.
service_state_gating.notes: Service state gating via CapabilityGate from rig_relay.governance.service_state. Profile must be unlocked before sensitive capabilities are available.

token_handling.html_injection_reason: pywebview local webview needs the token for WebSocket auth. Token is injected into index.html at serve time. This is a local-only surface.
token_handling.notes: Token is generated per server start (secrets.token_hex(32)). Never persisted to disk. Strip from /runtime-config.json HTTP response. Present in HTML injection for pywebview only. Logs show token_present (boolean), never raw token.

oauth_loopback_exception.notes: OAuth loopback listener (AuthSessionManager) runs on separate port, separate thread. Validates state hash with SHA256 comparison to prevent CSRF. Not governed by cockpit bridge token — OAuth callback is a distinct security boundary.

health_endpoint.notes: /healthz returns content-light readiness state only: bridge mode, transport label, service state, profile exists/state, TLS status. No tokens, no secrets, no projection data, no file paths.
